task.description: Security code gate for GH #2596. Read-only; no lib/ or test/ edits; mix not run.

result.summary: PASS. #2612 trigger check: NONE of ci.yml, cd.yml, scripts/cd_qa_decide.sh, scripts/ci_changed_paths.sh, mix.exs, config/*.exs, permission_matrix task/module, authorization.ex, catalog.ex, priv/permission_matrix is in the diff (git status and diff --name-only); exam.ex is the exam manifest, not the catalog. So #2612 does not apply; the gate applies on INV-1/4/5/6/7/8 (tenant-data migration). MIGRATION 20261016120001: trigger function opens only for OLD.managed_by IS NULL AND NEW.managed_by='exam' AND NEW.name = ANY(literal six-name array) AND current_setting('letflow.managed_by_stamp', true)='exam' AND to_jsonb(NEW)-'managed_by' = to_jsonb(OLD)-'managed_by'; unset/'' closed; DELETE branch unchanged; plain plpgsql (not SECURITY DEFINER); prefix() guard present; only the schema name from prefix() is interpolated; down text equals the previous body (compared against the existing function: identical statements); registered in @tenant_scoped_migration_manifest. STAMP: F-1 Repo.in_transaction?() refusal first (typed :nested_transaction, nothing written) plus last-statement set_config clear; F-4 satisfied: real_run takes set lock_timeout/statement_timeout (txn-local), ManagedTypes.lock_names, FOR UPDATE row fetch, and classifies from the LOCKED rows (advisory pre-pass only feeds dry run and the nothing-to-do skip); set_config('letflow.managed_by_stamp','exam') is bound-parameter and issued immediately before the single update_all(set: [managed_by: ...]) scoped by tenant_id, id in locked ids, is_nil(managed_by), explicit prefix; verify_stamped rolls back on gap; per-tenant transaction, failures isolated; reports/audit hold names, counts, reason atoms, exception modules only (reason_tag never keeps messages); no Logger of findings. TAMPER INVENTORY: first statement SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY, no write, SQL extracts only entity_type/record_id JSON keys, payload/field_values never selected into Elixir, idempotency_key read for classification but not emitted, nested refusal, no Logger, explicit prefix, bound params (B-3 met). RELEASE wrapper forwards only :module/:dry_run (stamp) and :module/:scope (inventory), dropping the after_precheck test seam and lock tuning. MIX TASKS: strict OptionParser, tag-only error text, exit 1 on failed tenant, findings to stdout only. EXAM CALL SITES: all six Records writes (session.ex x3, certificate.ex, anti_cheat.ex) pass ManagedTypes.owner_for!(Exam) built per call, never stored; manifest manages exactly the six frozen names. PACK: pack.json is 453 additions, 0 deletions (existing ten unchanged), 16 types in the designed order; generate_pack.exs lists the six new types.
advisories_non_blocking: A-1 (REQUIRED BEFORE CI, test owner not security): test/letflow/entities/managed_types_callers_test.exs @authority_callers (line ~60) lists only @handler_writes and @fixture_managed; the new exam Records callers (session.ex, certificate.ex, anti_cheat.ex) will fail T-17 (line ~597-600) and the origin-caller directory rule must be checked. TEST-DESIGNER must extend the allowlist as the moduledoc in managed_types.ex now states.

A-2 stamp.ex:307-316: the opener set_config stays open through verify_stamped and audit! until the final clear at :280. Harmless (same transaction, rolled back on any failure, neither touches entity_definitions updates), but clearing it immediately after update_all would match the design wording 'just before / just after' exactly. Optional.
A-3 T-11 tripwire (test-phase): assert set_config occurrences also inside fragment() literals/heredocs (B-2) and that the stamp fragment string appears only in stamp.ex plus the two migrations.
A-4 certificate.ex:363-367: the exam_owner/0 helper was inserted between the fetch_candidate_name comment block and its function, detaching that comment from its function (cosmetic, REVIEWER).
